description:
The proof order for your declared Decibel account, structured for your own order
        tool: market_addr, price_units, size_units, time_in_force=1 (post-only), is_buy=true,
        client_order_id, and a 'safety' block with GUARANTEED limits (buy only, post-only,
        market minimum size, price <= 60% of the mark, value <= $5, a market where you have no
        position or open order, 30 minutes). Verify every limit yourself; if anything differs,
        do NOT place it. Place it, cancel it by client_order_id at once; Pitbi notices it on
        its own. Pitbi never asks for anything else.
name: prove_account
